text:
9. 1. 2. 

Upaṭṭhānasuttaṃ

222. Ekaṃ samayaṃ aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe. tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu divāvihāragato supati. Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇaḍe adhivatthā devatā tassa bhikkhuno anukampikā atthakāmā taṃ bhikkhuṃ saṃvejetukāmā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami. 

Upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:

Uṭṭhehi bhikkhu kiṃ sesi ko attho supinena te, 

Āturassa hi kā niddā sallaviddhassa ruppato. 

Yāya saddhā pabbajito agārasmānagāriyaṃ, 

Tameva saddhaṃ brūhehi mā niddāya vasaṅgamīti. 

Aniccā addhuvā kāmā yesu mando'va mucchito, 

Khandhesu muttaṃ asitaṃ kasmā pabbajitaṃ tape. 

Chandarāgassa vinayā avijjāsamatikkamā, 

Taññāṇaṃ paramavodānaṃ kasmā pabbajitaṃ tape. 

Bhetvā avijjaṃ vijjāya āsavānaṃ parikkhayā, 

Asokaṃ anupāyāsaṃ kasmā pabbajitaṃ tape. 

Āraddhaviriyaṃ pahitattaṃ niccaṃ daḷhaparakkamaṃ, 

Nibbāṇaṃ abhikaṅkhantaṃ kasmā pabbajitaṃ tapeti.
